hints.title: Grade school
hints.body: Use the multiplication method taught for multi-digit numbers, working from right to left.

hints.title: Positional contributions
hints.body: The digit at position `i` of one number and position `j` of the other contribute to position `i + j + 1` from the right.

hints.title: Carry array
hints.body: Accumulate products in a digit array, then normalize carries and strip leading zeros.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if num1 == "0" or num2 == "0": return "0"
digits = array of length m + n filled with 0
for i from m - 1 down to 0:
    for j from n - 1 down to 0:
        product = value(num1[i]) * value(num2[j])
        total = product + digits[i + j + 1]
        digits[i + j + 1] = total % 10
        digits[i + j] += total // 10
skip leading zeros
return digits joined as text
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
